title: Rollout
description: A phased rollout of one change: ordered steps with a ring, percent, bake, gates and a failure action. Advancing only opens a PR; rollback and pause are automatic.

metricGoal.description: A metric guardrail on the backing experiment's arms.

metric.description: Normalised halo.* metric name (see internal/policy MetricRegistry).

maxRegression.description: Relative worsening that fails the gate, e.g. 0.05 = 5%.

name.description: Step name, unique within the rollout.

strategy.description: progressive / blue-green move the ring's release pointer (client axis); canary / holdout set the backing experiment's weights; dark-launch mirrors traffic via halo-shadow (traffic axis).

ring.description: Target ring. Required for progressive/blue-green; percent steps expose the backing experiment's rings.

percent.description: canary: treatment share; holdout: share kept on control; dark-launch: share of requests mirrored; progressive/blue-green: 100 (default).

bake.description: Minimum time at this step: a Go duration (30m, 24h) or whole days (14d).

minSamples.description: Minimum users per arm before the step may advance.

gates.description: All must pass before the step advances.

guardrails.description: Metric guardrails; a breach triggers onFailure at any time.

scorecard.description: Eval scorecard gate (halo eval run --output json).

file.description: Scorecard JSON, relative to the policy repo.

maxRegression.description: Largest allowed pass-rate drop vs the scorecard control (0.02 = 2pp).

approval.description: Hold until a human advances the step.

onFailure.description: What a gate breach does (default rollback).

axis.description: client: a release digest moves through rings; traffic: a gateway model route.

status.description: Only active rollouts are driven by the controller.

step.description: The live step, set by merged advance PRs; empty = not started.

experiment.description: Backing two-arm experiment (exposure, evidence, kill switch). Optional when every step is progressive or blue-green.

release.description: Client axis: release digest the ring pointers move to.

version.description: Client axis: human label of the release.

alias.description: Traffic axis: gateway model alias re-routed to the treatment's route on completion.

baseline.description: Known-good state a rollback returns to.
